title: Access Denied
caption: Access Denied (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. At Cloud City sites, Stunning Leader may not be played and your non-{lightsaber} Rebels of ability > 3 are immune to attrition < 4. {alter}
lore: The doors on Cloud City use a specialized computer controlled locking system, making them difficult to bypass without altering the security codes.
